children: Britain's Financial Conduct Authority said on Thursday it had taken action against illegal peer-to-peer cryptocurrency trading in London, targeting three premises suspected of operating unregistered crypto businesses.

The FCA said it had issued cease-and-desist letters to traders at all three locations after an operation conducted alongside Britain's tax authority and the police. The finance regulator did not identify the premises.
